d: Company Description MERCO GROUP BAHRAIN is an investment company established in 2004, focused on renewable energy and refining petroleum products through its group entities including Merco, Mashal Chemical, Mashal International, and RecycleAge. The company is a market leader in petroleum and petrochemical trading, and is one of the largest bitumen, solvents, white spirit, emulsions, MCS, and base oil manufacturing and refining companies in the Kingdom of Bahrain. Its core business includes physical trading, logistics, distribution, refining, shipping, and custom-made production, with the capability to supply bitumen and specialty products tailored to customer specifications. MERCO GROUP BAHRAIN has a strong track record of profitable operations, financial strength, and long-term strategic investments, and operates to the highest international HSE standards while exporting globally. The company is a proven partner for major international projects, including World Bank and United Nations initiatives, supported by extensive trading, technical expertise, and a global supply network.

Role Description This is a full-time, on-site role based in the Northern Governorate, Bahrain for a Freight Forwarding & Logistics Executive within MERCO GROUP BAHRAIN’s petroleum, petrochemical, and bitumen operations. The role involves coordinating and managing freight forwarding activities for exports and domestic shipments, ensuring timely and cost-effective transportation of products such as bitumen, base oil, solvents, and other petroleum derivatives. The Freight Forwarding & Logistics Executive will handle booking and tracking of freight, documentation, customs clearance processes, and compliance with international shipping and HSE standards. Day-to-day responsibilities include liaising with shipping lines, transport providers, and customers, resolving logistics issues, optimizing routes and transportation modes, and maintaining accurate records and reports. The role also requires close collaboration with trading, production, and finance teams to align logistics plans with business needs and to support dependable delivery performance for global customers.
q: Candidates should possess skills in Freight Forwarding and Freight Transportation, with experience in coordinating multimodal shipments and managing logistics operations.
Candidates should possess skills in Forwarding and Export processes, including documentation, customs procedures, and international trade regulations.
Candidates should possess strong Customer Service skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, manage expectations, and resolve issues with internal and external stakeholders.
Relevant experience in petroleum, petrochemical, or bitumen logistics, preferably within the GCC region, is highly beneficial.
Strong organizational, planning, and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and reporting.
Proficiency in standard office software and logistics/ERP systems, and familiarity with Incoterms and international shipping standards.

d: A restaurant manager’s primary role is to manage and control the day to day restaurant operations
Ensure that FOH and BOH staffs are familiar with the day’s requirement.
Ensure training of all staff is done prior to restaurant opening and whenever needed to maintain excellence of operation standards.

Responsible for coordination with all related parties during the Pre-opening Phase of the restaurant to ensure that the Opening Date is reached with full readiness of entire aspects of staffing, training, stocking, menu, budgets, Marketing Plan, and all other aspects of operations.
Ensure that all staff is treated fairly and with commonly accepted courtesy.
Ensure that time tables, leave roasters and attendance registers are up-to-date.
Coordinate with the executive chef and bartender for new menus as needed and to create a wide variety of new dishes and beverage list.
Ensure that all communications between restaurant and kitchen run smoothly.
Ensure that all purchased order have been delivered and stored.
Responsible for the Profit and loss statement of the restaurant.
Responsible for achieving set revenues and sales targets for the entire operation of the restaurant on both Floors.
Managing the prompt efficient and courteous serving of food and beverage in the restaurant.

Schedules working hours of all Service staff, taking into consideration volume of expected business (Reservations and timetables) and ensure that attendance registers are kept daily and that any absenteeism is immediately brought to the attention of the HR.
Ensure that all staffs are under control are fully informed in respect of disciplinary procedures, the handling of grievances, etc.
Ordering supplies and to ensure that all stocks are ordered to the correct quantities, quality and price.
Managing all administration procedure and ensure that all documents are sent to the appropriate accounts department immediately for processing.
Ensure that expenses are within budget limits.
Control and manage the monthly inventory.
Managing the day to day function of all restaurant employees, facilities, daily stock checks/stock takes and sales.
Ensure that all stocks are being kept securely and under the correct conditions applicable to each type of commodity stored
Managing the daily briefing with the staff to ensure smooth running of the service sequences
Hold weekly meetings with the Managing Partner to ensure that operation is going as it should and to ensure that any special arrangements are properly communicated.
Responsible for the PR and Marketing activities and communication in order to maximize exposure, footfall and sales revenues of both levels of Restaurant.

Generate weekly, monthly and quarterly reports on all aspects of the restaurant operations, including but not limited to budgets, cost breakdowns and sales breakdowns (per food categories, customer profile, menu items, days of the week, etc) Health, Safety and Security
Maintain the required standard of operational hygiene according to cleaning rotas at all times.
Be aware of the Restaurant policies and procedures relating to health, hygiene, and fire life safety and ensure your direct reports do the same.
Familiarize with emergency exits and evacuation procedures. Financial Management
To achieve the budget by monitoring and controlling the departmental operations, considering restaurant and expenditure.
On an ongoing basis, control and analyze departmental costs to ensure performance against budget;implementing corrective measures where necessary to produce positive business results.
Comply with the company's corporate code of conduct.
Familiarize yourself with the company values and model desired behaviors.
Perform tasks as directed by the Management in pursuit of the achievement of business goals.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking aims to be the international bank of choice for affluent customers, supporting their domestic and international banking, and holistic wealth management needs. We provide a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Global Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

Join HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking as a Premier Service Manager. You’ll support a team of Premier Wealth Relationship Managers (PWRMs), helping deliver an outstanding experience for affluent clients while enabling relationship managers to focus on client-facing activity and portfolio growth.
q: Experience in financial services, preferably in retail or Premier banking sales.
Knowledge of core banking products, the Premier proposition, and retail and wealth processes.
Experience using CRM or relationship-management platforms.
Understanding of branch operations and relevant local compliance requirements.
Strong communication, influencing, teamwork and client-service skills.
Ability to deliver needs-based solutions and a high-quality client experience.
Money Laundering Awareness certification is preferred.
Willingness to obtain any professional or regulatory qualifications required by the market.
A full-time degree of at least three years’ duration is essential for obtaining a UAE visa and work permit. Degrees awarded outside the UAE require valid attestation and equivalency documentation.

Under the New Labour Law, only fixed term contracts shall be available to all employees of HSBC UAE (except DIFC and ADGM employees) – hence in line with the term of work permit, a 4 years’ contract would be issued.
